messages:
neha: Heads up 1: the VPC default-deny egress + new KMS grant condition landed in prod earlier and our dev-pool GPU instances in us-west-2 are failing keystore decrypts during boot. join rate down ~38%.

omar: can you paste the error lines?

neha: snippet from node logs:
```
ERROR keystore.decrypt region=us-west-2 node=dev-gpu-3 status=403 grant=gr-99123 viaServiceAttr=false
WARN pool.join node=dev-gpu-3 reason="keystore handshake timeout"
```

jun: looks like the `kms:ViaService` condition is not present when requests are proxied through privatelink. we hit that exact edge in staging but thought scope was limited.

tara: quick mitigations: 1) temp fw allowlist for privatelink ENIs from dev-pool subnets (low-risk, fast), 2) scoped IAM tweak to remove the ViaService constraint for the affected grant ARNs (safer long-term but needs sec approval).

alex: cost note 1: allowlist -> increased NAT and audit shipper egress, estimate $900-1.6k/day for the region while warmup completes. finance ok for <48h if tagged and ticketed.

omar: i'll open FW-CR with TTL=90m and add ipset for privatelink range. command I'll run: `ipset add keystore-priv 10.10.5.0/26` then fw rule `allow from devpool -> ipset:keystore-priv port 443`. tagging with `keystore-temp-exception`.

ops-bot: INC-8499 created for dev-pool join failures. linked FW-CR 6021. estimated cost $1.2k/day. escalate to security@redwood if TTL>4h.

jun: plan: mar apply fw-CR (0-20m), verify joins (20-60m), alex draft PR to scope revert (60-120m), sec review and merge, then remove fw-CR.

neha: assign: omar=apply fw change, jun=monitor joins + metric alerts, alex=draft scoped PR for grants [gr-99123], tara=update SOC ticket and keep logs for 30d, neha=postmortem.

omar: FW-CR 6021 applied to staging as canary; warm joins recovered to ~96% in canary. applying to prod now.

jun: prod warm-pool join recovered to 94% after exception. KMS 403 spike subsided. continuing to monitor for 2 hours.

alex: PR opened https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/7421 1 - removes `kms:ViaService` condition only for grant gr-99123 and adds an integration test that exercises privatelink proxy path. requesting sec review.

ops-bot: INC-8499 updated: status=mitigating, mitigation=FW-CR 6021 + PR 7421, est-resolve=+2h.

neha: postmortem bullets: cause = ViaService condition incompatible with privatelink proxy; detection = warm-pool join metric drop + KMS 403 rate; mitigation = temp fw allowlist + scoped IAM revert; followups = add unit/integration tests for grant evaluation via privatelink, add rollout gating that runs warm-pool canary, add cost alert for NAT egress when exceptions applied.

omar: removing fw-CR after PR merged and canary validated. will annotate ticket with audit and cost tags.

neha: thx team. closing once fw-CR removed and PR merged.
